bio.text: Kevin Parker is a member of the New York State Senate representing District 21, an office he assumed in 2003, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot as the Democratic candidate for re-election.
Ballotpedia says he earned a B.S. from Pennsylvania State University in 1989 and an M.S. from the New School for Social Research in 1993.
His earlier work included being an instructor at Brooklyn College from 1993 to 1997 and special assistant to the Office of the New York State Comptroller from 2000 to 2002.
